title: DNA extraction of Nephila clavipes using the Wizard Genomic DNA Purification kit
author: Luiz Filipe Bartoleti
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.knxcvfn
materials: Homogenize gently for one minute. 00:01:00, Homogenizing

steps.title: Macerate legs in liquid nitrogen
steps.instruction: Using liquid nitrogen, macerate 1–8 legs (≈50 mg tissue) until finely powdered.

steps.title: Add Nuclei Lysis solution
steps.instruction: Add 600 µL Nuclei Lysis solution to the powdered tissue and homogenize thoroughly.

steps.title: Incubate at 65 °C
steps.instruction: Place the microtubes in a dry bath set to 65 °C and incubate for 1 hour.

steps.title: Add Protein Precipitation solution
steps.instruction: Add 200 µL Protein Precipitation solution to each tube and homogenize.

steps.title: Centrifuge 10 min
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the microtubes at 13 000 rpm for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Transfer supernatant and add isopropanol
steps.instruction: Transfer the cleared supernatant to a new microtube and add 600 µL isopropyl alcohol.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA at –20 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the tubes at –20 °C for at least 1 hour.

steps.title: Centrifuge 6 min at 4 °C
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 13 000 rpm for 6 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Wash pellet with absolute ethanol
steps.instruction: Discard the supernatant, then add 600 µL absolute ethanol to the pellet.

steps.title: Centrifuge 3 min at 4 °C
steps.instruction: Centrifuge the tubes at 13 000 rpm for 3 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Rehydrate DNA in TE buffer
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA pellet in 50 µL Tris‑EDTA buffer.
